markets.question: Will Nadeshot win the Founding Fathers Lan?
markets.description:

This market will resolve to “Yes” if Matthew Haag (Nadeshot) of 100 Thieves wins the Founding Fathers Lan Modern Warfare 2 competition. Otherwise this market will resolve to “No”.

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

The CS:GO BLAST Premier Fall Final 2024 for Counter-Strike: Global Offensive in is scheduled to take place over September 25-29, 2024. You can find more information about that tournament here: https://blast.tv/premier/fall-final-2024

This market will resolve to "Yes" if Astralis wins this tournament. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

If this team is eliminated from the competition based on the official rules of the tournament, this market will resolve to “No”.

If the winner of CS:GO BLAST Premier Fall Final 2024 is not determined by October 20, 2024 ET, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source for this market is official information provided directly from BLAST (e.g. https://blast.tv/) and official footage of the tournament, however other credible reporting may be used.
